scientific_integrity: Analytic derivation and standalone rational/numerical checker; all nonstandard bounds are proved in RESULT.md. Published source results and classical Cramer theory are credited.
scientific_limitations: For iid symmetric nonatomic compactly supported sampling/integration measures and degree-one ordinary least-squares quadrature. Asymptotic probability rate is logarithmic only. The exact three-sample probability and numerical rate specialize to the uniform law. Independent validation not performed.
title: Sharp negative-weight failure rates for affine randomized least-squares quadrature
